heading_en: Approval Before the Application Date Concerning the Exclusion Exception for Calculating the BI in the Standardized Measurement Approach
summary_ja: BI算出に係る除外特例の承認につき、前条第一項・第二項を準用する。
summary_en: Paragraphs (1) and (2) of the preceding Article apply mutatis mutandis to approval of the exclusion exception for calculating the BI.
paragraphs: Paragraphs (1) and (2) of the preceding Article apply mutatis mutandis to an Ultimate Designated Parent Company that intends to obtain approval concerning the exclusion exception for calculating the BI in the standardized measurement approach under Article 292 of the New Public Notice. In this case, in paragraph (1) of the preceding Article, the words "Article 287" shall be read as "Article 293" and the words "use of the ILM" as "exclusion exception for calculating the BI", and in paragraph (2) of that Article, the words "Article 286, paragraph (1) or (2)" shall be read as "Article 292" and the words "those provisions" as "that Article".
